commits_info.message:
Remove outdated Javadoc links

Closes gh-32873

Modernize Antora Build

- Use same playbook as docs-build
- Use Env Variables to cause partial build (same as docs-build)
- Use package.json so that dependencies can be updated with dependabot

Select most specific advice method in case of override

Closes gh-32865

(cherry picked from commit ea596aa211ea17b814099a73bb5a091a9af1cadd)

Default fallback parsing for UTC without milliseconds

Closes gh-32856

(cherry picked from commit fee17e11ba6668a5392c0db28c79d2d75be10c3d)

Avoid creation of SAXParserFactory for every read operation

Includes JAXBContext locking revision (avoiding synchronization) and consistent treatment of DocumentBuilderFactory (in terms of caching as well as locking).

Closes gh-32851

(cherry picked from commit a4c2f291d986ccf988f37af5466265a7f534c16a)

Avoid reader on empty content to be shared by multiple requests

This commit avoids several instances of MockHttpServletRequest to
have a common reader for empty content as closing it will have an
unwanted side effect on the others.

Closes gh-32848

Defensively catch and log pointcut parsing exceptions

Closes gh-32838
See gh-32793

(cherry picked from commit 617833bec97bdee369af01462b68f8878eb1b155)

issues.title: Review Javadoc links in build configuration
`@DateTimeFormat(iso = DateTimeFormat.ISO.DATE_TIME)` cannot convert UTC without milliseconds to `java.util.Date`
Avoid creation of SAXParserFactory for every read operation in Jaxb2Marshaller and co

Spring AOP fails against registered `@Configurable` aspect
Accept ajc-compiled `@Aspect` classes for Spring AOP proxy usage
